planets.name: TOI-2068 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2068 with a 7.77-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-2068 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2068. Its orbit and size follow Mistry et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
